voice_description: An adult male werewolf with a low tense baritone voice, dark breathy rasp, strong chest resonance, slightly rough edges, and a subtle restrained animalistic quality. Alert, intense, predatory, protective, and constantly maintaining self-control. His speech should sound fundamentally human and versatile, with the wolfish character remaining underneath rather than dominating every line.
direction: The werewolf becomes intensely threatening without growling heavily or shouting. Darker tone, stronger chest resonance, careful pauses, and tightly controlled anger.

text: Walk away. I am asking nicely because there are children behind me, and I would prefer they not see what happens next. Take your men, take your weapons, and leave this forest while that choice still belongs to you.
